text:
Ivy (PM): Morning team — 48h to lock the 8/1 release cutlist. Two friction points: multi-tenant embeddings cache (customer ask) vs prompt-templating (UX). Customer Beacon insists on embeddings. Options: (1) GA with non-cached embeddings + deprioritize templating, (2) gate cached embeddings to invite-only pilot + keep templating, (3) delay embeddings to v1 and ship templating. Fast takes pls.
Sam (Eng): infra log: KV-routing change for cache causes sporadic mem pressure under bursty long-seq loads. Non-cached vector path is low risk and ~3 dev-days. Pilot-cache needs provisioning + gating (~6 dev-days). Full cache is risky for GA.
Rohit (ML): cached path = +7% recall, much cleaner tail latency. Non-cached is OK for trials but will surface quality issues for Beacon. Pilot-lane gives them near-cache perf if we can isolate.
Tess (Design): templating helps onboarding a lot, but we can mitigate by surfacing curated examples if templating slips. That takes ~2 days UI work.
Maya (CS): Beacon prefers cache but will accept invite-only pilot if quotas and a rollback SLA exist. They want a one-week ramp and a post-pilot review.
Ivy (PM): my read: pilot-lane cache (option 2) buys quality for Beacon and avoids landing KV changes in GA. It does add infra work but isolates risk. Vote?
Sam (Eng): 2 (pilot-lane cache) — implement gating and a kill switch.
Rohit (ML): 2 — I'll add eval probes and acceptance thresholds for pilot.
Tess (Design): 2 — will design "invite-only" banner and quickstart.
Maya (CS): 2 with condition: documented SLA + onboarding checklist before enabling.
Ivy (PM): consensus = 2. Action list: @Sam open INFRA-5099 to provision dedicated pilot pool + kill switch; implement feature-flag pilot-cache; @Rohit add continuous recall and latency probes; @Tess draft pilot UX and comms; @Maya schedule Beacon onboarding and confirm SLA language; I'll update the milestone tracker and cut note.
deploy-bot: created feature-flag rollout/embeds-pilot-cache (staged=false)
Sam (Eng): opened INFRA-5099 and started PR for the gating layer (WIP).
Rohit (ML): added eval job to CI and dashboard widget (embeds-pilot-recall).
Tess (Design): uploaded pilot UX mock and copy to drive: https://rwd.example/pilot-ux
Maya (CS): emailed Beacon with proposed pilot plan + SLA draft, awaiting reply.
Ivy (PM): cut note filed: "MVP: defer multi-tenant embeddings cache to v1; provide invite-only pilot with dedicated cache pool for select customers; keep prompt-templating in MVP. Contingency: if pilot shows instability, revert to non-cached path and pause pilot onboarding." Tagging @launch-team. Keep updates in this thread. :rocket:
